name: Theatre of Life
source:
Chappy is going about his normal day when an unexpected turn of events forces him to confront the world around him and the truth within.

[From [url=https://yaonam.itch.io/theatre-of-life]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
查皮原本正像往常一樣過著自己的日子，一場意外的變故卻迫使他正視周遭的世界，以及藏在內心的真相。

［摘自[url=https://yaonam.itch.io/theatre-of-life]Itch.io[/url]］
